question: A language model breaks input text into smaller units before processing it. What are these units called?
explanation: Generative language models process text as tokens. A token can represent a whole word, part of a word, punctuation, or another text unit.
learningObjective: Describe how generative AI models work

optionExplanations.A: Generative language models process text as tokens.
optionExplanations.B: This locates the service interface; it does not configure the requested model capability; generative language models process text as tokens.
optionExplanations.C: This enables an agent to use configured capabilities or invoke external actions; generative language models process text as tokens.
optionExplanations.D: This refers to configured processing units, not the token units a language model reads; generative language models process text as tokens.

question: You need to send a very large document to a generative AI model in one request. Which model characteristic is especially relevant?
explanation: The model’s context window limits the tokens it can consider for a request. For models with a combined input/output context budget, the document, instructions, conversation history, and generated output must fit within that budget. Also check the model’s separate maximum input and output limits.
learningObjective: Describe how generative AI models work

optionExplanations.A: This identifies or configures the language used for speech or text processing; the model’s context window limits the tokens it can consider for a request.
optionExplanations.B: The model’s context window limits the tokens it can consider for a request.
optionExplanations.C: This describes image dimensions rather than the model’s token context or requested analysis; the model’s context window limits the tokens it can consider for a request.
optionExplanations.D: The number of configured tools does not specify how many document tokens fit in a request; the model's context limits do.

question: A search feature must find documents with similar meaning even when they use different words. Which model capability is most appropriate?
explanation: Embedding models represent content as numeric vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.
learningObjective: Identify an appropriate AI model, based on capabilities

optionExplanations.A: Embedding models represent content as numeric vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.
optionExplanations.B: This converts text into spoken audio; embedding models represent content as numeric vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.
optionExplanations.C: This locates individual objects and can return their bounding boxes; embedding models represent content as numeric vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.
optionExplanations.D: This creates new visual content from a prompt; embedding models represent content as numeric vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.

question: Put this simplified retrieval-augmented generation workflow in the most appropriate order.

items.text: Retrieve relevant trusted information
Add retrieved information to the model context
Generate a grounded response
Receive the user question

explanation: RAG starts with a request, retrieves relevant information, adds it to the model context, and then generates an answer grounded in that information.
learningObjective: Describe how generative AI models work

question: In this Responses API call, client is an authenticated OpenAI-compatible client connected to Foundry, and model_name contains the deployment name. Which argument value selects the deployment?
code:
response = client.responses.create(
    model=model_name,
    input="Summarize this feedback."
)
explanation: For this Foundry API, pass the deployment name, which may differ from the underlying model’s catalog name or ID.
learningObjective: Create a lightweight chat client application by using the Foundry SDK

optionExplanations.A: For this Foundry API, pass the deployment name, which may differ from the underlying model’s catalog name or ID.
optionExplanations.B: This is the object returned by the API call; it does not select which model deployment to invoke; for this Foundry API, pass the deployment name, which may differ from the underlying model’s catalog name or ID.
optionExplanations.C: The input argument supplies the prompt content, not the deployment name used by the model argument.
optionExplanations.D: client.responses is the client's response API interface; its create method sends the request, while the model argument selects the deployment.

question: An application needs to invoke a deployed model but the team does not want to use an SDK. Which interface can the application use?
explanation: Deployed Azure AI capabilities can be accessed programmatically through supported REST APIs as well as SDKs.
learningObjective: Create a lightweight chat client application by using the Foundry SDK

optionExplanations.A: Deployed Azure AI capabilities can be accessed programmatically through supported REST APIs as well as SDKs.
optionExplanations.B: This styles a web page; it does not provide an HTTP interface to a model; deployed Azure AI capabilities can be accessed programmatically through supported REST APIs as well as SDKs.
optionExplanations.C: This selects synthesized voice output rather than an API for model inference; deployed Azure AI capabilities can be accessed programmatically through supported REST APIs as well as SDKs.
optionExplanations.D: This is a classification result rather than an application interface; deployed Azure AI capabilities can be accessed programmatically through supported REST APIs as well as SDKs.

question: A user is successfully signed in but cannot invoke a protected Azure AI resource. Which concept determines whether the user has permission to perform the action?
explanation: Authentication establishes identity. Authorization determines what that authenticated identity is permitted to do.
learningObjective: Create a lightweight chat client application by using the Foundry SDK

optionExplanations.A: Authentication establishes who the user is; successful sign-in does not itself grant permission to invoke a resource.
optionExplanations.B: Authorization determines which actions the authenticated user may perform on the protected resource.
optionExplanations.C: Tokenization splits model input into tokens; it does not grant resource permissions.
optionExplanations.D: Image classification assigns labels to images; it does not determine whether an authenticated identity is authorized to invoke a resource.

question: An agent must create a Jira ticket after diagnosing a support issue. What enables the agent to perform that external action?

options.text: A configured tool or function connected to Jira

explanation: Agents use configured tools or functions to interact with external systems and carry out actions.
learningObjective: Create and test a single-agent solution in the Foundry portal

optionExplanations.A: Agents use configured tools or functions to interact with external systems and carry out actions.
optionExplanations.B: This concerns how much tokenized input and output the model can process; agents use configured tools or functions to interact with external systems and carry out actions.
optionExplanations.C: This changes image quality but does not connect an agent to an external ticketing tool; agents use configured tools or functions to interact with external systems and carry out actions.
optionExplanations.D: This converts text into spoken audio; agents use configured tools or functions to interact with external systems and carry out actions.

question: For each statement, select Yes or No.

items.text: Object detection can locate objects within an image.
Image classification normally assigns a category to the image as a whole.
OCR is primarily used to synthesise spoken audio.
A multimodal model can combine visual and language understanding.

explanation: Object detection includes location, classification identifies categories, OCR reads text, and multimodal models can process more than one input modality.
learningObjective: Identify features and capabilities of computer vision and image-generation models

question: OCR successfully returns all text from a scanned invoice, but the application needs reliable named fields such as supplier, invoice number, date, and total. Which AI-901 capability is the better fit?

options.text: Azure Content Understanding with a structured schema

explanation: OCR reads textual content, while Content Understanding can extract and organise unstructured multimodal content into a user-defined structured format.
learningObjective: Extract information from documents and forms by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

optionExplanations.A: OCR reads textual content, while Content Understanding can extract and organise unstructured multimodal content into a user-defined structured format.
optionExplanations.B: This converts text into spoken audio; oCR reads textual content, while Content Understanding can extract and organise unstructured multimodal content into a user-defined structured format.
optionExplanations.C: This creates new visual content from a prompt; oCR reads textual content, while Content Understanding can extract and organise unstructured multimodal content into a user-defined structured format.
optionExplanations.D: This classifies the opinion expressed in text; oCR reads textual content, while Content Understanding can extract and organise unstructured multimodal content into a user-defined structured format.

question: Match each stage of a voice assistant to the appropriate capability.

items.text: Microphone audio becomes written text
Written response becomes spoken audio
Positive or negative opinion is identified in written feedback

explanation: Speech recognition is audio-to-text, speech synthesis is text-to-audio, and sentiment analysis evaluates opinion in text.
learningObjective: Build a lightweight application by using Azure Speech in Foundry Tools

question: A recruitment solution that screens resumes has several governance issues. Match each issue to the most directly relevant responsible AI principle.

items.text: Comparable applicant groups experience substantially different rejection rates
Applicants are not told that AI is used
No team is responsible for appeals and escalation
Unnecessary confidential applicant data is retained

explanation: Different outcomes relate to fairness, disclosure to transparency, ownership to accountability, and unnecessary sensitive-data retention to privacy and security.

question: Put these steps for a simple Foundry model workflow in the most sensible order.

items.text: Identify application requirements
Select an appropriate model
Deploy the model
Test the deployment in the portal
Call the deployment from application code

explanation: Requirements drive selection; the model must be deployed before testing and client integration.
learningObjective: Deploy a model and interact with it in the Foundry portal
